description: DPF - Domaine public fluvial is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Service de la navigation fluviale. River public domain. Coverage: Service de la navigation fluviale. The portal shows the English title as "DPF - River public domain" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Service de la navigation fluviale. Its keywords include bateau, vorschleusung, privatrechtliche-nutzung, schifffahrt, voie-navigable, navigation. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is notspecified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
